title: Multiple Files (:e, :bn, :bp)
instruction_text:
Work with multiple files in Vim!

':ls' = list all buffers (try this!)
':bn' = next buffer
':bp' = previous buffer
':b filename' = switch to specific buffer

Your task: Two files are open.
Switch to task2.txt and add 'COMPLETED' to it.

Steps:
1. Type ':ls' and press ENTER (see both files)
2. Type ':bn' or ':b task2.txt' to switch to second file
3. Press 'A' to append at end of line
4. Type ' COMPLETED'
5. Press ESC
6. Type :wq to save and quit all buffers

Note: Both files are already loaded!
Use :bn to switch between them.
target_content: This is the second file (task2.txt) COMPLETED
